dataset: Falko-MERLIN German GEC Corpus - WNUT 2018 release
change: Preserve case and definiteness when the observed article supports one unambiguous replacement.
Abstain from rewrites when case cannot be recovered safely.
Ignore spaced nominal compounds where the apparent noun may modify a following head.
limitations: Ten holdout rewrites are a safety signal rather than a stable population accuracy percentage.
The detector covers a bounded interview noun lexicon and does not measure general article or case accuracy.
The detector emitted only 11 signals against 1274 general holdout determiner-form annotations.
The corpus is written learner German, not Egyptian Arabic-L1 spoken BPO interview German.
